messages:
alice_billing: Heads-up: INV-5110 ($11,600) ACH debit returned with NACHA code `R01` (insufficient funds). Originator: Meridian Logistics. Return posted this morning. Need recovery plan — invoice due in 3 days. @rachel_csm @tom_treasury

payments-bot: ACH return event: return_code=R01; return_reason='Insufficient Funds'; trace_no=9876543210; returned_amount=11600.00; logged to /payments/INV-5110. Dunning resumed.

tom_treasury: R01 is straightforward. Options: 1) automated retry in 5 business days (standard), 2) immediate manual retry if customer authorizes, 3) offer card or same-day wire as fallback. For $11.6k we usually require payer email consent for a manual retry.

rachel_csm: I just called their AP. They said cashflow hiccup; can make a partial payment today for $5k and cover remainder next week. They asked if we can accept a split payment and not escalate collections.

alice_billing: We support split captures but need written agreement. Two questions: will they allow ACH re-debit for remainder, or prefer card/bank transfer? Also we need to update invoice to reflect partial payment.

tom_treasury: For ACH re-debits after an R01, bank rules allow a re-present if customer authorized it in the original authorization. Do we have express re-present permission on file?

payments-bot: Authorization note: original ACH authorization captured as ACH_AUTH_2026 includes 'allow re-present' = false (customer didn't opt-in). File at /auths/ACH_AUTH_2026.

rachel_csm: They don't remember opting in. CFO asked if we can take a card for the $5k now and then schedule an ACH re-debit for the remainder once they confirm. They will provide email that authorizes the ACH re-present.

legal_sam: If they provide explicit email consent that includes: invoice number, amount(s), and authorization to re-present ACH for the outstanding balance, that's acceptable for audit. Store consent on payment ticket. For card we need the same payer approval if charging a corporate card.

alice_billing: Proposed plan: (A) accept $5,000 by card today (customer will email consent + card link), (B) pause collections and schedule ACH re-debit for remainder in 5 business days after receiving signed email authorization, (C) flag invoice as 'payment plan pending' in ledger. Approve? @tom_treasury

tom_treasury: Approve with condition: add a note to require CFO in cc on the consent email for any ACH re-present > $10k cumulative in 30 days. Also document the re-present as 'second-present' in our payment record.

payments-bot: Creating payment plan record: PP-1987654321. Actions: send secure card collection link, pause dunning 7 days, await email consent for ACH re-present. Link: https://pay.redwood/collect/INV-5110-pp1987654321

rachel_csm: Sent email to customer with card link and requested consent text. I asked them to cc their CFO on the ACH re-present email and include expected date for the second payment.

alice_billing: Note for ops: Will create invoice credit memo for $5k once card capture completes and schedule remaining balance as scheduled debit. Also ensure accounting marks revenue appropriately per recognition policy.

bankops-bot: FYI: repeated R01s from the same originator within 30 days increase dispute risk and potential NSF fees. Recommend we limit re-present attempts to 2 and escalate to collections on third failure. Filing ops task BL-5088 to add a retry cap in billing engine.

rachel_csm: Customer captured $5k by card and emailed consent for ACH re-present with CFO cc'd. Card capture successful. They confirmed plan to release ACH on 2026-04-03 for remaining $6,600.

payments-bot: Card capture OK. Payment plan PP-1987654321 updated: remaining scheduled ACH re-present date=2026-04-03; amount=6600. Dunning paused until 2026-04-04. Closing thread and monitoring.
